# Security

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do **not** open a public issue. Report privately:

- **Contact**: GitHub private vulnerability reporting is not enabled in this
  repository, so report directly to `jonathansoto.dev@gmail.com` with the
  details below.

## What to include

- Affected project and version.
- Vulnerability description and impact.
- Reproduction steps.
- Proof of concept (if available).

## Response timeline

| Step | Expected timeframe |
|------|--------------------|
| Acknowledgment | 48 hours |
| Triage & assessment | 5 business days |
| Fix release | 30 days |

## Supported versions

| Version | Supported |
|---------|-----------|
| Latest release | ✅ |
| All previous releases | ❌ |
